title: Go-live call: deploy DeskBook to dev now, production later?
detail: The re-audit passes with conditions. 748 backend and 215 frontend tests pass; 150 of 166 MVP criteria pass and 16 need dev. Dev deploy is GO once the frontend build is copied into the approuter (B1) and B4/B5 are done. Production is NO-GO until your scans (B7), the dev-stack proofs (B9), backup and restore, DE/FR legal sign-off, alert names and the CSRF decision are closed. You and the dev team run every deploy command.

options.label: Go to dev, hold production
options.detail: Team closes B1, B4, B5; you deploy to dev and run the scans; production comes back to you as G4 again

options.label: Hold
options.detail: Tell the team what to change before any deploy
